item.title: New (Free) Guide Shows Toronto Homeowners How To Tap Into ‘Missing Middle’
item.description: Liam Gill doesn’t describe himself as a developer, but that hasn’t stopped him from carving out a place in Toronto’s development landscape. Now, the lawyer and tech entrepreneur wants to help others do the same with his Citizen Developer’s Guide, released Wednesday morning in collaboration with More Neighbours Toronto.The guide is designed for people like Gill — those without a formal background in real estate development, but with an interest in densifying their own home or investment property.

item.title: CREA: Winter Storms Suppress January Home Sales
item.description: Canadian home sales started 2026 on a colder note, with activity dampened by severe winter weather across parts of the country.According to new data released Tuesday by the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA), home sales recorded over Canadian MLS® Systems fell 5.8% month-over-month in January.
